title: imap-receipt-sweep manifest line
description: One JSON object per line in <inbox>/.sweep-manifest.jsonl — one per file the sweep saved. Consumers key on message_id for de-dupe and on kind for routing.

message_id.description: The RFC 5322 Message-ID, angle brackets included. The de-dupe key across accounts and runs.

account.description: Which configured mailbox it came from — the config file's stem, e.g. 'personal'.

date.description: The message's Date header as YYYY-MM-DD.

from.description: Sender address (the addr-spec, not the display name).

kind.description: The classification. 'skip' is never written — skipped mail has no manifest line.

file.description: File name relative to the inbox folder: YYYY-MM-DD_<sender-slug>_<subject-slug>.<ext>.

amounts.description: Money amounts seen in the message, as decimal strings, largest first. May be empty.

vendor.description: Best-effort vendor name as the message presents it.

renews_on.description: For a renewal-notice: the date the message says the charge will occur.

swept_at.description: When this line was written (local time, ISO 8601).
